contents.content: Near TEKsystems Global Services in Bangalore, there are several residential neighborhoods and areas that offer convenient living options for employees. Here are a few notable ones:

About 10-15 kilometers from TEKsystems Global Services, Whitefield has many homes to choose from and is easy to get to using the Outer Ring Road. It’s in the east part of Bangalore and is liked by IT workers. You can find big housing areas with gates, houses, and rental apartments in Whitefield. It’s also near big IT places like ITPL.

Right next to Whitefield, Marathahalli is about 10-12 kilometers from TEKsystems Global Services and you can get there easily using the Outer Ring Road. It’s a busy place with lots of IT companies. There are many homes here, from ones that are easy on the wallet to fancy ones with gates. Marathahalli is also close to places where you can work, shop, and have fun.

Bellandur is tucked away near the Outer Ring Road, about 10-12 kilometers from TEKsystems Global Services. It’s a nice quiet spot in the busy city. Bellandur is growing fast and is easy to reach from TEKsystems Global Services. It has apartments and houses, with many safe, gated areas that have cool things like pools and parks. It’s also near big places where lots of people work in IT, like Ecospace and Prestige Tech Park.

Not far from Whitefield, Brookefield is around 10-15 kilometers from TEKsystems Global Services. You can get there easily using the Outer Ring Road and Old Airport Road. Brookefield is a calm place with lots of trees and offers different kinds of homes, including apartments and separate houses. It’s also easy to get to places where people work and shops from Brookefield.

Near places like RMZ Ecospace and Embassy Tech Village, Sarjapur Road is about 10-12 kilometers from TEKsystems Global Services. You can reach it easily using the Outer Ring Road. Sarjapur Road is growing quickly and has many new homes being built for people who work in IT. There are homes for all budgets, from less expensive apartments to fancy houses. Sarjapur Road is also close to places where many people work, which is handy for TEKsystems Global Services employees.

A bit further away, Koramangala is about 15-20 kilometers from TEKsystems Global Services. It’s a lively area with lots of things to do and places to go. Koramangala has different kinds of homes, like fancy apartments, separate houses, and PGs (paying guest accommodations). It’s well-linked to Whitefield and Sarjapur Road, so getting around is easy.

These areas near TEKsystems Global Services in Bangalore have many different homes to choose from, fitting all kinds of tastes and wallets. They make it easy for employees to find a good place to live near their work.
